objective: Visualize flow chaining dependencies with green dashed edges on the Automation Overview Canvas and display CRON/WEBHOOK trigger badges on FlowSummaryNode cards matching Figma spec.

acceptance.criterion: useFlowCanvas calculates animated green dashed chain edges for valid next_flow_ids targets and ignores missing target script IDs.
FlowSummaryNode renders CRON and WEBHOOK badges with corresponding teal and indigo color tokens when script trigger type is cron or webhook, and omits badges for sensor/fsm.
Frontend quality gates pass cleanly without errors or warnings (tsc --noEmit, eslint ., vitest run, npm run build).
acceptance.verification: Terminal verification logs for frontend build, lint, typecheck, and vitest runs
